prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Finish a premium ARC Daily competitor portrait in the editor-approved GLAMOROUS CYBERPUNK character aesthetic. Hand-painted/airbrushed graphic-novel realism with sculpted inked facial planes, rich tactile metal, dramatic cinematic light; the SAME coherent illustration treatment across face, skin, hands, costume and machines. The editor explicitly wants idealized handsome heroic characters BASED ON their references, not literal actual photographic faces. Smooth flattering painted complexion, balanced attractive features, stronger sculpted jaw/cheekbones, groomed hair, expressive striking eyes. No pasted-on head, pores/blemishes copied from a snapshot, photographic skin, anime, retro pulp halftone or generic superhero stranger. Preserve only broad signature identity cues while glamour-redesigning the face. Enormous graphics cards, visible PCBs, cooling fans, heat sinks, copper/coolant pipes and geometric ARC-square displays define this world. Facial optics and headset integrate physically into temple/ear/cheek/collar machinery. This is fantasy character design, not evidence about actual methods, spending or formal team jobs.

These are NVIDIA CITADEL characters. The NVIDIA fortress must have its OWN look: vast sleek BLACK-GRAPHITE and EMERALD-GREEN GPU superstructure, monumental parallel server aisles and towering fan walls, angular cantilevered command decks, green-lit coolant conduits and distant snowy mountains. One subtle green NVIDIA-style eye pictogram may establish the faction, but NO lettering. No Tufa spiders, spider symbols, factory-yellow gantries, academy domes or copied Tufa room. Crimson accents suggest worthy elite rivals, not villains. No evil scowl, skulls, threatening minions, or franchise costume/actor likeness.

Portrait5:7, ideally1500x2100, full bleed with no frame. Head/upper-body, all essential face, hands and hero apparatus inside upper70%, face near upper third; calmer dark lower quarter for later programmatic trading-card graphics. Absolutely NO names, letters, digits, labels, ranks, medals, text, logos with lettering, scoreboards, comic titles, banners with writing, captions, watermark or card border. Only the illustration: another assistant adds all baseball-card typography/badges/stats later. ONE main character. DARRAGH HANLEY: THE NVIDIA CITADEL TACTICIAN. Image2 gives broad inspiration only: mature clean-shaven man, receding short dark/gray hair, long face and big warm toothy smile. DELIBERATELY REINVENT him as a handsome distinguished illustrated cyber tactician: stronger jaw, cleaner sculpted cheekbones, bright alert eyes, groomed dark hair with tasteful gray temples, subtly idealized refined nose and engaging knowing smile. Smooth perfectly painted/airbrushed skin, not the actual snapshot face or skin texture. Do not make him Puget or Jeroen, do not add either man's beard or curls. The image must unmistakably read as a designed glamorous fictionalized character, not a cutout photograph wearing a costume.
Different narrative role and equipment: STANDING three-quarter at a broad cantilevered NVIDIA CITADEL RAMPART PLANNING TABLE, body turned toward viewer, one gloved hand resting on an elaborate huge mechanical map projector and other guiding a formation of three small floating GRAPHICS-CARD CARRIAGES above the table, miniature compute architecture rather than a generic puzzle cube. Confident resourceful elite strategist, friendly competitive charm. Portrait at head-to-hip scale, face high and readable.
Equipment/costume distinct from the seated mastermind: asymmetrical BLACK-GUNMETAL and EMERALD engineer-command jacket, deep CRIMSON sash-like integrated harness panel at the waist (rigid practical panel, no loose scarf/cape), brushed silver high collar, robust one-sided GPU field-rack worn diagonally on his back with an enormous exposed fan and finned cooling radiator. A slim chrome headband with twin small green optical lenses mounted OFFSET beside one eye, elegant ear receivers, articulated cheek communications hardware and visible cables connect into collar. Leave the smile and most idealized face visible. A large fold-out circuit-board control bracer unfolds across one forearm; other sleeve mostly fabric with a few square ARC grid modules, not matching two armored sleeves. No giant generic jeweled armor. Behind him stretches the separate NVIDIA citadel's illuminated EMERALD server canyons, angular black catwalks, green coolant loops and snow seen through a far geometric opening. Warm copper light and small crimson accents separate his friendly face and silhouette. No throne, no Tufa spiders or yellow gantry room. Preserve respectful warm rival character, not villainy.

references.role: Established Puget ILLUSTRATED character: human facial painting and integrated cyber hardware style only, not his beard/hair/face.
Darragh's own author portrait: loose broad inspiration for mature receding dark/gray hair, smile and long clean-shaven face; deliberately handsome glamour redesign, not exact photo face.
Editor-approved Jeroen art: dramatic illustrated polish only, not his identity, throne pose, outfit or Tufa setting.

review: Illustrated mature NVIDIA tactician in emerald GPU citadel with crimson harness accents, distinctive field-rack and three floating compute carriages over a map table. Preserves warm broad smile as an idealized painted character rather than card typography. No stats or borders baked into art.
commissionAuthority: Boss prioritized Lukas and DZ retro conversions, then six integrated-face-hardware cyberpunk repairs on 30 October 2026.
